WEB_HOST.description: Address the web container is published on; keep 127.0.0.1 behind a reverse proxy on the same host.
WEB_HOST.comment:
Where the site is published: the LXC's own LAN address, so Caddy on
raspberrypi3b reaches it (the firewall allows only CADDY_ADDRESS).
Replace <CT ID> with the container ID, which is also the last octet of
its address.

WEB_PORT.description: Host port the site is published on.

VITE_CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Contact email embedded in the bundle at build time; empty keeps the default in apps/web/src/config/site.ts.
VITE_CONTACT_EMAIL.comment:
Contact details, embedded in the bundle at build time (README, "Contact
variables"). Empty keeps the defaults in apps/web/src/config/site.ts
(elvisgastelum@proton.me and WhatsApp 526381177267). The WhatsApp number
is digits only, country code first; `off` hides the WhatsApp link.

VITE_CONTACT_WHATSAPP.description: WhatsApp number, digits only with the country code first; `off` hides the WhatsApp link, empty keeps the default.
VITE_CONTACT_WHATSAPP.patternMessage: must be digits (country code first), `off`, or empty for the default

COMPOSE_FILE.description: The compose files every plain `docker compose` command uses: the base file plus the production override.
COMPOSE_FILE.comment:
Every plain `docker compose` command run from the repo root uses the base
file plus the production override, under a stable project name (container
names stay the same across deploys).

COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME.description: A stable compose project name, so container names stay the same across deploys.
COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME.patternMessage: must be lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`, starting with a letter or digit

IMAGE_TAG.description: The running release: scripts/deploy.sh sets it to the deployed commit's short hash.
IMAGE_TAG.patternMessage: must be a Docker image tag
IMAGE_TAG.comment:
The running release: scripts/deploy.sh sets it to the deployed commit's
short hash and rolls back to the previous value when a deploy fails. Set
it to the checkout's short hash before the first start
(`git rev-parse --short HEAD`); `latest` names no commit, so a failing
deploy after it cannot roll back automatically.

CADDY_ADDRESS.description: The address Caddy (raspberrypi3b) connects to this LXC from; only the firewall rule uses it.
CADDY_ADDRESS.comment:
The address Caddy (raspberrypi3b) connects to this LXC from: its LAN
address, or its Tailnet address if the Caddy upstream is a Tailnet name.
Only the firewall rule in docs/deploy/homelab.md uses it; the static site
reads no forwarded headers.

files.description: The keys docker-compose.yml reads, with their local defaults.
The production template for the homelab LXC.
files.header:
Production settings for the homelab LXC (docs/deploy/homelab.md). Copy it
to .env at the repo root on the host and keep it there only:

  cp deploy/.env.production.example .env && chmod 600 .env

Generated by configure-env from env.schema.json: edit the schema, not this
file, which the tool rewrites.

Nothing here is secret (the contact details end up in the public bundle),
but .env is the host's own copy: scripts/deploy.sh rewrites IMAGE_TAG in
it and it is never committed.
